data.name: Haanii
data.gender_notes: Haanii is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Haanii is a name of Arabic and Islamic origin that signifies delight, joy, happiness, and contentment. The name Haanii carries the meaning “Delight, Joy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haanii usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
